title: 'Cherokee' at the Savoy
summary: In New York the band swung 'Cherokee' on the air at the Savoy and kept it going for the whole half hour.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: And we were in the Savoy Ballroom, and we did "Cherokee," and it was up there fast. (singing).
And we swung that place to death.

McShann said something about -- that they were on the air from the Savoy and that the announcer was going to quite a hip guy or or something, and then you got started, whether it was "Cherokee" or what, went through the whole half
And stretched it. The guy said, 'Let him go, let him go.'
That's right, sure did. And we really swung that place.
Another thing Jay said about that was that you really had some battles there, that --
Oh, yeah, we had to battle each band that played on that side, you see.
